definitions.explanation: A person assigned to relay information and coordinate communication between groups, departments, or individuals.

examples.japanese: {連絡係|れんらくがかり}に{伝|つた}えてください。
examples.english: Please pass the message to the contact person.

examples.japanese: クラスの{連絡係|れんらくがかり}を{任|まか}された。
examples.english: I was assigned to be the class liaison.

examples.japanese: イベントの{連絡係|れんらくがかり}として、{参加者|さんかしゃ}{全員|ぜんいん}に{日程|にってい}{変更|へんこう}を{知|し}らせなければならない。
examples.english: As the event liaison, I have to notify all participants of the schedule change.

notes:
A compound of {連絡|れんらく} (contact, communication) and {係|がかり} (person in charge). Common in schools, workplaces, and organizations where someone is designated to relay messages and coordinate communication between groups.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連絡係|れんらくがかり}を{務|つと}める: to serve as liaison
- {連絡係|れんらくがかり}を{任|まか}される: to be put in charge of communications
- クラスの{連絡係|れんらくがかり}: class contact person
- {連絡係|れんらくがかり}に{連絡|れんらく}する: to contact the liaison person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {窓口|まどぐち}: point of contact, counter — the designated person or office for inquiries
- {担当者|たんとうしゃ}: person in charge — broader, the person responsible for a task or area
- コーディネーター: coordinator — loanword, implies broader organizational responsibilities
